description: Issues a structured invoice as an EU e-invoice and returns a signed download URL. standard: zugferd or factur-x give a PDF/A-3b with the XML embedded (readable by people and machines; for Germany prefer zugferd); xrechnung-cii or xrechnung-ubl give the XRechnung XML only (German public sector; needs invoice.buyer_reference = Leitweg-ID and electronic_address on seller and buyer). Totals and VAT are computed from the lines. The PDF uses the built-in invoice layout unless template_id is given. By default a TEST document (watermarked, not counted); set test to false only when the user explicitly asks for a live invoice.

filename.description: File name of the PDF, e.g. "invoice-1042.pdf".

invoice.description: The structured invoice (EN 16931). Totals are computed from the lines. Other fields of the API EInvoice schema (allowances, charges, delivery, billing_period, preceding_invoice, ...) are passed through.

electronic_address.description: E-mail (scheme EM, default) or another CEF EAS address. XRechnung needs it for seller and buyer.

vat_id.description: VAT id with country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

unit_code.description: UN/ECE Rec 20: C62 piece (default), HUR hour, DAY day, KGM kilogram.

category.description: S standard (default), Z zero rated, E exempt, AE reverse charge, K intra-community, G export, O not subject.

terms.description: Payment terms text. Either terms or due_date is required when an amount is due.

electronic_address.description: E-mail (scheme EM, default) or another CEF EAS address. XRechnung needs it for seller and buyer.

vat_id.description: VAT id with country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

profile.description: Default en16931 (zugferd/factur-x) or xrechnung (xrechnung-*). Leave out unless the user asks.

standard.description: zugferd / factur-x: PDF with embedded XML. xrechnung-*: XML only.

template_id.description: Optional: a template for the visible PDF instead of the built-in invoice layout.

test.description: true (default): a watermarked test document that is not counted against the plan. Set false ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a live, final, unwatermarked document. A test API key always makes test documents.

name: create_e_invoice
title: Create an EU e-invoice
